title: Creation of a Bank of Biological Materials and Associated Data Related to Patients With Infectious and Tropical Diseases
official: Creation of a Bank of Biological Materials and Associated Data Related to Patients With Infectious and Tropical Diseases
summary: This is the protocol that formalizes the establishment of the TROPICA-BIOBANK biobank
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Informed consent (for healthy volounteers also: age \> 18 years, health status ascertained by laboratory tests, electrocardiogram and medical examination)

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of alcohol/drug abuse
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women, unless there are justified and documented needs
sponsor: IRCCS Sacro Cuore Don Calabria di Negrar
